brief: The canvas depicts a dynamic cosmic flow of interconnected, vibrant shapes in constant motion. These fluid forms interweave and ripple across the screen, creating a sense of deep, ethereal energy. As the primary shapes move, they release trails of spent, non-luminous energy. This energy momentarily condenses, forming intricate, temporary webbing of pale, glowing light that connects the surfaces of the shifting shapes. The entire scene is a self-contained, perpetual cycle of flow and gentle luminosity.
